column2: Catalogue brand string "Kentucky" is not a real producer -- it is a generic geographic/category word mis-extracted as a brand, bundling at least two confirmed-unrelated real bourbon brands from different companies: "The Wiseman" (Kentucky Owl, contract-distilled with Bardstown Bourbon Company, per Breaking Bourbon) and "Benchmark" (Sazerac Company, per Wikipedia: "Sazerac acquired several brands from Seagram, including McAfee's Benchmark"); plus an unconfirmed "Kentucky Walker" and "Fordman" (a retailer listing attributes Fordman to Heaven Hill Distilleries, not independently confirmed this session). No single producer named "Kentucky" exists.
